target.name: ByteCodeInterpreter bit-array reader (sub_08004364)
target.role: test one bit of the byte array the effect routine writes, and return 0 or 1
target.notes: sub_08004364, 28 bytes and 14 instructions, two terminators at 0x0800437A and 0x0800437E, no calls and NO literal pool. A LEAF sitting immediately before the setter sub_08004380, with the clearer sub_08004396 immediately after it, so the three tile 0x08004364..0x080043AC as one bit-array accessor trio. THE INDEX SPLIT IS IDENTICAL TO THE SETTER'S: `asrs r2, r1, #3` selects the byte and the `lsls r2, r1, #0x1d` / `lsrs r2, r2, #0x1d` pair isolates the low three bits, so it reads the byte at base + (value >> 3) + 0x55, the same byte the setter writes. The byte-index shift is ARITHMETIC, so a value with bit 31 set reads BEFORE the base, exactly as the setter writes. IT TESTS THE BIT FOR SET: `ands` masks the byte with 1 << (value & 7) and the routine branches on whether the result is zero. THE RETURN VALUE IS A NORMALISED BOOLEAN, 0 or 1, not the masked byte, so a caller cannot see which bit was masked. IT WRITES NOTHING: there is no store anywhere in the routine, which is what makes it a reader rather than the setter or the clearer. There is NO BOUNDS CHECK and no NULL check. THE FIRST OBSERVABLE CONSEQUENCE: three call sites consume the boolean, and all three treat the bit as a predicate - at 0x080007C4 the boolean is materialised into a word slot by `str r0, [r4]`; at 0x080007DA the INVERTED boolean is materialised by `movs r1,#1 ; subs r0, r1, r0 ; str r0, [r4]`; and at 0x080032EE the boolean gates setting a bit in a packed local word (`cmp r0,#0 ; beq ; movs r0,#1 ; lsls r0,r4 ; orrs r6,r0`), a gather loop copying set bits out of the array. So the bit's first concrete consequence is that it becomes a 0/1 value in an engine slot, and one caller deliberately inverts it. WHAT THE BIT MEANS IS STILL UNKNOWN: no semantic name is assigned to the flag, the array or the object, the array's size is unknown, and what reads the materialised word afterwards is not followed. Nothing is imported from another title.

bit_field_read.has_bounds_check_evidence: no compare against a size and no conditional branch other than the bit test itself
bit_field_read.read_semantics: reads the byte at base + (value >> 3) + 0x55 and returns 1 when bit (value & 7) is set, else 0; the byte is never written
bit_field_read.consequence: the boolean is materialised into an engine slot at two sites (one directly, one inverted) and gates a bit-gather at a third
